name: caol.reference_camp_gear_reentry_focused_mcw
description: Owner-reference continuation of the actual saved zombie encounter to seek a genuine active-guard perception opportunity.

forbidden_input: direct NPC action, perception, alarm, attack, damage, zombie respawn, actor teleport, clock, payment or return injection

steps.label: observe_reference_camp
steps.objective: Continue this existing zombie encounter as a survivor until actual active-guard detection and response or a concrete reason that opportunity cannot occur. Use ordinary armed, door and route judgment and preserve genuine consequences. Then save and close.
proof_targets: exact source and installed world, actual saved actor and encounter continuity
actual Tilda active-guard sightline opportunity and observed detection or first missing premise
actual alarm and per-actor appropriate response or evidenced exclusion, if reached
genuine survivor and zombie outcomes, native exit and process custody
invariants: saved encounter is zero-credit starting state; prior contact and Casey injury retain original run identity and must not be erased
do not spawn a second zombie, teleport actors or inject detection, alarm, attack, damage or outcome
ordinary survivor, door and route decisions are allowed without prescribing a tile sequence
do not require both residents to attack or be on duty simultaneously; report real eligibility and exclusions
do not repeat earlier gear, signal or physical-source work
